args.name: Evidence-based food sample assessment
args.function: Assess an owned unfamiliar food sample using feasible physical tests, reporting only what the tests establish about edibility, toxicity, nutrition, or required preparation, with explicit uncertainty.
args.conditions: I am beside the mature hazelnut plant start-1-nuts. Direct observation established stock and growing conditions, not food safety. Hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, and preparation requirements are unknown to me. Known berries remain available in my inventory.
args.inputs: A real owned food sample if needed; any tools, reagents, prerequisites, and sample quantity must be specified before testing.
args.costs: Method, time, energy, materials, and learning requirements are unknown. Prefer a low-risk reusable method; no eating an unknown sample merely to infer safety.
args.effects: Enable an actual bounded investigation with measured findings and stated limitations. Do not reveal hidden properties without a supporting test or claim that a negative limited test guarantees safety.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.
